title: Harden shared tunnel process state transitions
description: Make the shared engine’s process lifecycle states idempotent, evidence-based, and safe across deploy, stop, restart, and failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Start/stop/restart operations are idempotent and do not create duplicate process handles or timers
Running/degraded/stopped state is derived from current process/systemd evidence after cache expiry
A failed start does not leave a runtime marked running without processes
Dispose/redeploy invalidates process and status caches correctly
Shutdown is bounded and reports cleanup failure

steps.description: Use test doubles for process handles to cover duplicate start, stop-before-start, partial process failure, cache invalidation, and bounded dispose.
Update `TunnelEngine`/process handles only at the root cause identified by the failing tests, preserving existing public methods and error types.
Publish bounded lifecycle events/logs for start, stop, restart, failure, and cleanup without including secrets.
Run the lifecycle tests, the custom harness, typecheck, and lint.

technicalNotes: The current engine already has a 3-second process cache; tests should prove invalidation and evidence refresh rather than assume a new design.
